mining_map.coordinate_provenance_statement: Coordinates (Latitude/Longitude) are transcribed directly from the project source artifact mining_map_phase8.csv as collected during the 2026-09-08 Phase 8 audit. All coordinates are verified within Indian coalfield geographical bounds. They represent project-audited data and have not been independently ground-truth surveyed via differential GPS or verified by external satellite telemetry.
mining_map.star_rating_notice: Star Rating is NOT present in the source CSV and is NOT simulated or displayed.

gsi_reports.source_origin: GSI Exploration Report Catalogue (Google Drive / GSI REPORT)
gsi_reports.description: Bibliographic metadata for coal and lignite exploration reports across GSI regions.
gsi_reports.borehole_notice: Actual borehole intercept logs, depth intervals, seam thicknesses, and proximate coal-quality measurements are NOT present in this dataset.

ocbis_blocks.source_origin: Online Coal Block Information System (Google Drive / GSI REPORT / OCBIS.html)
ocbis_blocks.description: Coal block names, legislation act types, coalfields, and allocation status.

geological_model_safety.label: SIMULATED GEOLOGICAL MODEL — NOT ACTUAL BOREHOLE MEASUREMENTS
geological_model_safety.disclaimer: The 3D geological view illustrates a representative Gondwana coalfield stratigraphic succession based on published GSI/CMPDI literature. Actual borehole measurements are not available in the audited dataset and must not be inferred from the 3D model.
